# @dxtmisha/scripts

> CLI tools, AI integration scripts, and automation utilities for the DXT UI ecosystem.

Provides automated Vue component scaffolding, Figma layout synchronization, library packaging, documentation generation via AI (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI), visual regression screenshot capturing, prompt builders, and monorepo build orchestration.

## CLI Commands & Binaries

- [dxt-component](bin/design-component.ts): Scaffolds complete Vue component directory structure (`.vue`, `props.ts`, `styleToken.scss`, and exports).
- [dxt-constructor](bin/design-constructor.ts): Builds and links component constructors and token bindings.
- [dxt-figma-layout](bin/design-figma.ts): Synchronizes Figma layout tokens with code.
- [dxt-flags](bin/design-flags.ts): Rebuilds SVG flag assets and country dataset.
- [dxt-library](bin/design-library.ts): Automatically generates `library.ts` barrel files across packages.
- [dxt-package](bin/design-package.ts): Scaffolds new monorepo packages with standard directory structure and templates.
- [dxt-prompt](bin/design-prompt.ts): Generates consolidated `ai-prompt.md` files and synchronizes `AGENTS.md` rules.
- [dxt-screenshot](bin/design-screenshot.ts): Puppeteer-based automated component screenshot capture across themes.
- [dxt-types](bin/design-types.ts): Generates AI-optimized `ai-types.md` technical references, MCP config, and description files.
- [dxt-types-save](bin/design-types-save.ts): Fast offline rebuild of `ai-types.md` and MCP resources from cache without calling AI APIs.
- [dxt-ui](bin/design-ui.ts): Full UI component, constructors, and documentation rebuild pipeline.
- [dxt-wiki-storm](bin/design-wiki-storm.ts): Scans component wiki definitions and generates WebStorm / IDE live templates and metadata.
- [dxt-build-packages](bin/build-packages.ts): Builds monorepo packages that have version changes or custom build commands.
- [dxt-build-publish-packages](bin/build-publish-packages.ts): Scans and publishes changed monorepo packages to the npm registry.

## Programmatic Entry Points

- `.` ([src/library.ts](src/library.ts)): Full suite of classes including `DesignTypes`, `LibraryAiPrompt`, `ComponentCreator`, `PackageFile`, `PropertiesFile`, and `PropertiesConfig`.
- `./ai` ([src/library-ai.ts](src/library-ai.ts)): AI providers (`AiGoogle`, `AiGoogleLite`, `AiClaude`, `AiOpenAi`, `AiZAi`, `AiAntigravityCli`) and composable `useAi`.
- `./figma` ([src/library-figma.ts](src/library-figma.ts)): Figma API orchestration (`DesignFigma`, `DesignFigmaTokens`, `DesignFigmaClasses`).
- `./ui` ([src/library-ui.ts](src/library-ui.ts)): UI constructors and component scaffolding (`ComponentCreator`, `DesignConstructors`, `DesignFlags`, `DesignUi`, `DesignWikiStorm`, `PackageInit`).
- `./config` ([src/config.ts](src/config.ts)): Ecosystem constants, regex patterns, and default file paths.

## Optional & AI Resources

- [ai-resources/componentPrompt.md](ai-resources/componentPrompt.md): Rules and schema for prompt generation and AGENTS.md synchronization.
- [ai-resources/componentMaterials.md](ai-resources/componentMaterials.md): Standards for analyzing component mockups and specifications.
- [ai-resources/componentWiki.md](ai-resources/componentWiki.md): Guidelines for component documentation and wiki generation.
- [README.md](README.md): Command documentation and programmatic usage guide.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Version history and feature updates.
- [package.json](package.json): Package metadata, dependencies, binaries, and export maps.
